description: Relations the Atlas marks as contested or that carry conflicting studies, with both sides of the evidence. status says which; breakdown splits the total. A contested relation with no conflicting study listed is flagged conflicting_studies_missing and shows related relations named in its text. Paged: pass next_offset as offset for the rest. Optionally limited to one entity.

brief.description: Shorten the long boundary and note text (text_truncated is set); get_relation has the full text.

dedupe.description: Send a repeated study in full only once. Pass false for a full card every time.

limit.description: Maximum 50; a larger value is capped at 50.

offset.description: For the next page: pass next_offset from the previous answer.

only_contested.description: Keep only relations the Atlas flags contested, not those that merely carry conflicting studies.

name: find_contradictions
title: Find contested claims
